dek: Police today (August 11) appealed to the public for information on a woman who went missing in Kwai Chung. Tang Fei-lin, aged 50, went missing after she left her residence in Tai Wo Hau Estate on January 1, 2025 afternoon. Her family made a report to Police on August 8, 2026. She is about 1.5 metres tall, 68 kilograms
